versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of frontend-backend-dev

- No file changes or user-visible updates detected in this release.
- Documentation and all coding guidelines remain the same as the previous version.

Initial release.

- Introduces comprehensive guidelines for full stack development using TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js 14, React, Supabase, GraphQL (Genql), Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, and Shadcn UI.
- Details coding conventions, preferred patterns, and directory structure for components, services, and shared code (monorepo).
- Specifies practices for error handling, validation, authentication, AI integration (Vercel AI SDK), and real-time data with Supabase.
- Establishes naming, styling, accessibility, testing, and documentation standards.
- Includes recommendations for responsive design, security, and optimal use of Next.js server/client components.
